parts.text: This question is about metals and alloys.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Table 2.1 shows information about the reactions of four different metals with oxygen. Table 2.1 metal reaction with oxygen calcium burns rapidly to form an oxide cobalt burns slowly to form an oxide platinum no reaction tin forms an oxide but does not burn Put the four metals in order of their reactivity. Put the most reactive metal first. least reactive most reactive [2]

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
calcium > cobalt > tin > platinum (2)
if 2 marks are not scored: 1 mark for 1 pair reversed (consecutive) OR
platinum > tin > cobalt > calcium

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
any two of:
•
cobalt has a high melting point / boiling point / lithium has a low melting point / boiling point
•
cobalt has a high density / lithium has a low density
•
cobalt is strong/hard / lithium is weak/soft

parts.text: (c) Brass and stainless steel are alloys.
